title: Memory: Pool allocator (fixed-size slots, bitmap)
acceptance_criteria: Pool struct defined with slot size, slot count, bitmap, and memory region
pool_init(slot_size, slot_count) allocates and initializes pool
pool_alloc() finds first free slot via bitmap scan and returns pointer
pool_alloc() returns NULL when pool is full
pool_free(ptr) marks slot as free in bitmap
pool_free() validates pointer belongs to pool before freeing
Bitmap operations use efficient bit manipulation (test, set, clear)
Unit test verifies allocation, freeing, full pool, and invalid free
